authority.allowed_inputs: The same pinned local Task source and three opened public Agent outcome vectors.
authority.implementation_scope: One direct audit script and focused tests; the frozen candidate implementation and parameters remain unchanged.

source_results.outcome_status: Opened. This audit can challenge or narrow the nomination but cannot strengthen it into confirmation.

audit_contract.target: Determine whether the joint-Markov nomination is plausibly temporal and reference-panel transferable, rather than a repository imbalance, outcome-permutation artifact, or three-Agent in-panel matching artifact.
non_solutions: changing the Markov prior, horizon, state encoding, budget, or fitting repositories
choosing a more favorable permutation seed or count after observing the audit
evaluating held-out Agents with a Selection that used their outcomes
calling a favorable retrospective audit independent confirmation

leave_one_agent_out.rule: For each held-out Agent, rebuild joint states, cross-repository transition matrices, target-local transitions, forecasts, and ten-Task Selections from the other two Agents only; evaluate candidate-minus-full-history loss on the held-out Agent only.
leave_one_agent_out.aggregation: Origins equal within repository; repositories equal in wide and deep summaries.

temporal_null.rule: Independently within each repository, shuffle complete joint three-Agent outcome vectors over Task order; refit every outer-repository Markov model and Selection under the shuffled data, preserving repository outcome marginals and inter-Agent dependence.
temporal_null.as_good_or_better_direction: permuted difference less than or equal to the observed negative difference

retain_candidate_for_independent_agent_v: macro mean over the three held-out-Agent wide summaries is negative
at least two of three held-out-Agent wide summaries are negative
decision_rule.retain_only_as_panel_conditional_candida: The temporal-null rate is below 0.10, but either held-out-Agent condition fails.
decision_rule.retire_candidate_after_adversarial_audit: The temporal-null as-good-or-better rate is at least 0.10.

claim_limits: Complete non-target repository histories are used for outer fitting, so the audit is repository-held-out but not global-calendar prospective.
Three leave-one-Agent-out folds are a diagnostic, not an independent Agent panel.
The original seven-repository interval crosses zero and remains unchanged by this audit.
